verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents an official MCP integration. Its docs give a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio, exposing `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` from one server process that keeps page state across calls. A v3 MCP integration section adds plain-English browser control, and the team notes on HN that its Stagehand MCP server won Anthropic's MCP hackathon. Missing for 10: detailed MCP server setup/configuration and transport options beyond stdio, and independent (non-vendor) hands-on corroboration.
